problem_type: A store write-after subscription promotes a generation node during an explicit multi-step edge-and-mode write, changing the caller-selected input role or mode.
symptom: On the current implementation, building a first-frame input and then explicitly selecting its first-frame mode leaves the target in the wrong mode; the same shared subscription causes five CI failures across quick actions, storyboard approval and runner state construction.
direct_cause: generationCanvasStore.subscribe called the combined mode reconciler for every nodes/edges write, and that function included the promotion branch based on the intermediate graph state. Explicit edge-role and mode writes therefore raced the subscription; the subscription could promote again before the caller finished.
class_root: Promotion and empty-input reversion were incorrectly owned by the same all-writes trigger. The shared boundary lacked an invariant that explicit multi-step writes keep their caller-authored edge role and mode while only input disappearance is reconciled after store/document writes.
affected_population: Video first-frame, last-frame and first-last workflows built through multi-step quick actions or Agent/storyboard writes
Director camera-reference writes and any future caller that creates an edge before explicitly setting the target mode
All store/document writes that remove the final reference input while the composer is closed
entry_points: All nodes/edges store and document writes run the empty-input reversion subscription.
The connect gesture paths call deriveTargetAfterConnect, whose only promotion write is promoteTargetMode.
Generation composer, submit-time reconciliation and paid-card readers remain consumers; they do not own the store projection.

external_sources.purpose: React recommends calculating derived state from existing state and moving event-caused writes to event/shared boundaries instead of an Effect.
ComfyUI documents connect and disconnect as graph operations on node inputs.
Blender documents dragging a link away as disconnecting the socket and restoring an unconnected input.

invariants: The store/document subscription changes mode only when the target has no live reference input and textModeToReturnTo returns an explicit text mode.
Promotion is performed only by the connect gesture through deriveTargetAfterConnect and resolveTargetModeForEdge.
After an explicit multi-step edge then mode write, edge modes and the caller-selected mode remain unchanged; corrections use history:false and are idempotent.

door_reduction.why_not: The input-reducing user, Agent and document doors remain required and still converge through the store subscription. The two surviving mode owners are intentionally separate: promoteTargetMode is the connect-gesture write door, while revertTargetModeForEmptyInputs is the all-store-writes empty-input door; merging them recreates the intermediate-state overwrite. Submit and paid-card readers remain separate defensive consumers.

generality_proof: Every input-reducing caller still mutates the same nodes/edges store identity and is observed by the subscription, so empty-input reversion is independent of UI mount, caller, import format, undo direction or platform. Every connect gesture converges on deriveTargetAfterConnect, so promotion is independent of which gesture entry created the edge. Explicit multi-step callers are protected because the subscription no longer runs promotion at intermediate states.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Observe every nodes/edges write and invoke only empty-input reversion after the write.
Own the connect-gesture postcondition and delegate its sole promotion decision to promoteTargetMode.
Use the shared slot and text-mode rules to revert only targets whose reference inputs are all gone.

invariant_owner_layer.why: Promotion and empty-input reversion are separate explicit functions at the shared canvas derivation boundary; the store subscription is only the trigger for reversion.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: The subscription sees the edge-array change and class tests cover last-edge removal and atomic undo.
The class tests execute the same add-node, edge-write and explicit mode-write order used by the recipe and keep its edge roles.

same_class_entry_points.entry_point: original first-frame projection and batch confirmation
same_class_entry_points.evidence: The two baseline storyboard failures are reproduced before the fix and the full creation directory is rerun after the fix.
The class test models a director video reference edge followed by an explicit target mode write; the subscription no longer re-promotes it.
Submit-time reconciliation remains a defensive reader-side fallback and is unchanged; promotion stays in the connect gesture as required by the approved direction.
The paid-card projection is outside this canvas line and no card code is changed.

recurrence.reason: Any current or future caller that writes an edge and then an explicit mode can expose the same intermediate-state overwrite if promotion is attached to the all-writes subscription. Any caller that removes the final reference can expose stale mode if reversion leaves the store boundary.
same_class_scan: src/workbench/generationCanvas/store/canvasModeFollowsInputs.test.ts covers disconnect, source deletion, uploaded-reference removal, restore, undo and explicit first/last/first-last/director writes.

prevention.invariant: The all-writes subscription may only revert reference/edit/character/single intent to text when live reference inputs are empty; connect gestures alone may promote based on the newly connected edge.
prevention.failure_mode: If no archetype, no compatible text mode or no live input fact can be established, no speculative mode switch occurs; existing capability admission and submit-time reconciliation remain responsible for reporting unusable generation.
prevention.strategy: Keep promotion at deriveTargetAfterConnect and empty-input reversion at the store subscription, use shared capability and slot functions for both decisions, and use history:false so reversion remains part of the triggering write history.

legacy_paths.rationale: The obsolete composer effect and its component-only write path were removed in the earlier implementation and remain absent. This corrective change removes only the subscription promotion branch and does not add a fallback.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party dependency decides Nomi's archetype modes or reference slots; React guidance informed removal of the effect but no dependency change is needed.

migration: No stored schema migration is needed. Existing snapshots and document writes still pass through the same subscription; only their mode projection behavior changes so explicit modes are preserved and empty references still return to text.
residual_risks: Real Electron bilingual walks and screenshot review still need to run in the isolated profile for this corrective round.
A mode intentionally selected for an empty first/last-frame workflow remains unchanged by textModeToReturnTo, matching the existing product rule.
